name: JoAi: List Installs

description.en: List device installs for push campaigns (including anonymous). Filter by push status and search name, email, platform, or provider ref.
description.de: Liste Geräte-Installationen für Push-Kampagnen (inkl. anonym). Filter nach Push-Status und Suche nach Name, E-Mail, Plattform oder Provider-Ref.
description.fr: Liste les installations d'appareils pour les campagnes push (y compris anonymes). Filtrez par statut push et recherchez nom, e-mail, plateforme ou réf. fournisseur.
description.es: Lista instalaciones de dispositivos para campañas push (incluidas anónimas). Filtra por estado push y busca nombre, email, plataforma o ref. de proveedor.
description.it: Elenca le installazioni dispositivo per campagne push (anche anonime). Filtra per stato push e cerca nome, email, piattaforma o ref. provider.
description.ro: Listează instalările de dispozitive pentru campanii push (inclusiv anonime). Filtrează după status push și caută nume, email, platformă sau ref. provider.

bot: Use before creating a push campaign when you need install hashids, or to check who is subscribed. Prefer pushStatus=subscribed for sendable devices. Pass returned id values as installIds to Create Campaign.

inputs.name: Push status
inputs.bot: Pass subscribed to list sendable installs for push campaigns.

description.de: Suche nach Kontaktname/E-Mail, Plattform (ios|android|web), Bundle-ID oder Provider-Ref
